products.name: ResearchRabbit
products.note: Research discovery AI; paper recommendations; collaboration features; academic data

profile_text.body:
ResearchRabbit is a web-based research discovery tool aimed at academics and researchers. The company describes its platform as helping users save time on literature reviews by finding related papers, building citation maps, and tracking research trends, all powered by AI. The tool analyzes bibliographies, citations, and co-author relationships to surface connected articles, and refines its recommendations as users select additional papers, learning their interests over time.

The platform's core product, also called ResearchRabbit, falls within the search and research category and includes paper recommendations, collaboration features, and access to academic data. A librarian at Sam Houston State University is quoted on the company's site describing it as designed to help researchers visualize connections between existing research and streamline discovery, potentially eliminating what the site characterizes as an overwhelming and time-consuming literature review process. No litigation, patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
